pendentes.titulo: Quarto que ajuda a dormir: luz, temperatura, ruído e materiais
pendentes.alt: Quarto sereno ao entardecer, com cama baixa de linho claro, cabeceira estofada, piso de madeira e cortinas pesadas entreabertas
pendentes.pedido: A serene minimalist bedroom at dusk with a low platform bed dressed in off-white linen and a soft upholstered headboard in warm beige. Wide-plank oak floor, a small wool rug, a walnut bedside table with a low ceramic lamp giving dim amber light. Heavy floor-length blackout curtains in sand color, slightly open to a deep blue evening sky. Calm, uncluttered, interior design photography, eye level, soft natural tones.

pendentes.titulo: Regularização de construções: Campinas prorroga programa social até 2028
pendentes.alt: Plantas de arquitetura enroladas sobre uma mesa de madeira ao lado de uma trena e de uma pequena maquete branca de casa térrea
pendentes.pedido: Rolled architectural blueprints with no readable text resting on a light oak table, next to a closed metal tape measure and a small white architectural model of a single-story house with a gabled roof. Soft natural daylight from a large window on the left, shallow depth of field, calm neutral tones. Close-up still life, interior photography, eye level.
